messages:
nina: Heads-up — on the latency dashboard for /v1/respond the p50 is flat but p95/p99 keep flipping depending on the time slice. feels like merged percentiles are being driven by a tiny subgroup. plot: https://dash.redwood/internal/respond_tail.png

tao: Which estimator are we showing? approx_percentile over rollup summaries?

nina: Yes: `approx_percentile(latency_ms, 0.95)` applied to ingestion rollups. We recently changed routing weights which might have pushed a few requests to a slower variant.

ellie: If a fallback route with n<20 has a huge tail it can dominate merged p95 even though overall traffic is healthy. Do we surface subgroup sample counts on the chart?

nina: Not today. Dashboard only shows merged line. Oncall got paged and spent 20m chasing infra that wasn't broken.

telemetry-bot: rollout/weight-update service=respond route=slow-variant old=0.02 new=0.12 user=tao at=2025-03-20T11:05:01Z

tao: Quick export: overall p95=310ms (n=620), primary p95=300ms (n=600), slow-variant p95=1450ms (n=8). tiny group but huge impact.

ellie: Two immediate fixes: (1) add a `#samples` pill next to each percentile series (flat n display), (2) show a low-confidence state when subgroup_n < 30 with tooltip "low sample power".

ta o: typo (tao): also add a small caret action: "split by route_variant" to toggle per-variant lines. that will stop pagers from assuming systemic regression.

nina: Backend tweak: telemetry API should expose `?include=percentile_sample_counts` returning flat arrays: tags[], counts[], totals[]. keep it non-nested. That will let the console render pills without heavy payloads.

ellie: Long term: migrate to t-digest sketches for percentiles in rollups + persist `sample_count` and `merge_error_pct`. Console can gray-out percentiles where merge_error_pct > 10%.

ta o: again tao: for the rollup migration we need deterministic merge keys and a compatibility plan for older rollups. Also add synthetic test harness that creates skewed shards to validate merge error.

nina: Filed ENGPLAT-1515 for UI pill + split toggle, ENGPLAT-1516 for API sample_counts param, ENGPLAT-1517 for t-digest migration + validation harness.

ellie: UX note: pill should show `n=8` and when available `~err=12%` as small text. if n < 10 show warning icon and suggested action: "split by route_variant".

ta o: backend PR will cap returned groups to top 40 and include a truncation flag, returning only flat arrays to match current telemetry client expectations. sanitize tag values to maxlen=64 to avoid abusing payloads.

nina: telemetry-bot: can we annotate charts automatically with rollout/deploy events so we don't have to manually cross-reference?

telemetry-bot: noted  adding annotation for events matching rollout.* and deploy.* to latency dashboards in the next ingestion patch.

ellie: Great. short-term plan: ship sample-pill + tooltip in console (hotfix), add API flag for sample counts, and annotate the chart. then run t-digest migration tests in staging.

ta o: I'll own the backend API change. nina will prototype the UI. ellie will update the runbook to mention "expect percentile churn when subgroup n < 30".

nina: Will post PR links and staging results here once ready. thanks — should cut down noisy oncall pages. :thumbsup:
